role: independent visual reviewer of six Root-authored rasters
method: Whole six bilingual goals read; six originals and twelve actual display captures each personally inspected via view_image at original detail. Input bytes and whole-goal identities checked separately. All six decisions below precede post-FIRST author metadata reading.

wholeGoal.title: Tier- und Pflanzenarten bestimmen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann unterschiedliche Tier- und Pflanzenarten mithilfe geeigneter Merkmale und Bestimmungshilfen bestimmen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can identify different animal and plant species using suitable traits and identification aids.

independentReasoning.observation: A lobed oak branch with an acorn and a red spotted beetle are examined through two magnifiers beside an open illustrated identification aid. Separate leaf shapes and beetle markings in the book connect traits with a branching comparison aid. No species names, measurement data or complete operational key are shown.
independentReasoning.science: Suitable visible morphological features and an identification aid fit the whole DE/EN goal. Neither the pixels nor this verdict establish a specific beetle species from spot count, a validated complete dichotomous key, or successful learner identification. The book remains a pictorial aid icon.
independentReasoning.geometry: The branch, acorn, beetle, magnifiers and book are distinct. The book faces the viewer; no actor is depicted reading a reversed page. Occluded appendages are ordinary cartoon perspective, without an evident duplicated anatomical structure.
independentReasoning.readability: Leaf lobes, acorn, red beetle, spots and the aid remain distinct at 360 and 680. No essential tiny textual label carries the explanation.

rows.boundedUse: Didactic orientation illustration within the whole goal; no task completion, whole operator evidence, real experiment or human execution claim.

wholeGoal.title: Systematikansätze vergleichen und beurteilen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann historische und aktuelle Ansätze zur Systematisierung von Lebewesen vergleichen und deren Aussagekraft beurteilen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare historical and current approaches to classifying organisms and evaluate their explanatory value.

independentReasoning.observation: The left panel groups bat and bird under Flügel; frog and cat lie outside. The right panel Verwandtschaft shows a rooted four-taxon tree: frog diverges before the amniotes, bird before the sampled mammal pair, and cat and bat share the most recent displayed node.
independentReasoning.science: The displayed topology correctly distinguishes this sampled wing analogy from mammalian relatedness. Horizontal position is not an evolutionary rank. This is a small comparison of grouping principles, not a complete species phylogeny or a historical source document.
independentReasoning.geometry: Branches connect to explicit junctions rather than crossing ambiguously. Bat and bird are separate terminal illustrations, and the mammal grouping is visibly distinct from the bird branch. Winged bat anatomy is a schematic forelimb illustration.
independentReasoning.readability: Both panel headings and the principal grouping/tree topology remain readable at 360 and 680. The small terminal labels are secondary to clear animal icons; the core contrast does not require reading those small labels.

rows.boundedUse: Didactic orientation illustration within the whole goal; no task completion, whole operator evidence, real experiment or human execution claim.

wholeGoal.title: Modernen Menschen erdgeschichtlich einordnen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Place Modern Humans in Geological History
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Verlauf der Geschichte des Lebens skizzieren und verdeutlichen, dass der moderne Mensch eine erdgeschichtlich junge Art ist.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can sketch the history of life and show that modern humans are a geologically young species.

independentReasoning.observation: A large Schematische Zeitspur heading identifies a broad left-to-right arrow with early-life and fish icons. Plants and extinct reptiles are arranged as background historical motifs. A tiny far-right terminal interval leads to a magnified pair of modern humans.
independentReasoning.science: The deliberately schematic arrow and tiny terminal human interval communicate that modern humans are geologically young. There is no numerical calibration, proportional geological scale, direct ancestor chain, or assertion that humans coexisted with the displayed extinct reptiles. The human pair is in a separate magnified late-time callout.
independentReasoning.geometry: The magnifier relates enlarged humans to the arrow endpoint rather than placing them as a large duration segment. The arrow progression and terminal sliver remain visible. Background motifs are not organism-to-organism descent arrows.
independentReasoning.readability: The main heading, long arrow, endpoint marker and human callout survive both actual display widths. Small early-life icons are schematic orientation elements; neither age calculation nor exact date reading is required.

rows.boundedUse: Didactic orientation illustration within the whole goal; no task completion, whole operator evidence, real experiment or human execution claim.

wholeGoal.title: Fossildaten und Datierung
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Fossilfunde, Datierungsmethoden und deren Aussagekraft für Stammbäume bewerten.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can evaluate fossil finds, dating methods, and their significance for family trees.

independentReasoning.observation: Two fossil types occupy separate sedimentary layers, with a magnifier inspecting the lower coiled fossil. A separate laboratory inset shows a researcher holding a rock fragment beside a sample tray and microscope; a clock symbol points to the rock. The large heading is Alter und Kontext.
independentReasoning.science: Stratigraphic context, preserved morphology and a dating-question motif fit fossil evaluation. The picture supplies no absolute dates and makes no claim that an optical microscope measures isotope ratios, that the two fossils are direct ancestors, or that one pictured method proves an entire family tree. Absolute/relative dating reliability remains actual task content.
independentReasoning.geometry: Layer boundaries, shell and coiled fossil are distinct. The fossil magnifier enlarges its target; the laboratory inset is separated from the outcrop. The researcher faces the sample she holds, with ordinary occluded-finger perspective.
independentReasoning.readability: The heading, layered context, fossil shapes, magnifier and clock/rock relationship are clear at 360 and 680. No clipped main object or essential tiny numeric scale is present.

wholeGoal.title: Genfluss und Migration
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Effekte von Migration und Genfluss auf Populationen beurteilen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can assess the effects of migration and gene flow on populations.

independentReasoning.observation: A blue-dominated beetle population lies on the left bank and an orange-dominated one on the right. An arrow and bridge show one beetle moving left to right. At the recipient bank a blue/orange pair, heart and downward arrow lead to small differently colored offspring. The heading is Migration + Fortpflanzung.
independentReasoning.science: The movement plus reproduction distinction correctly gives the mechanism by which migration can contribute gene flow. Color is a schematic heritable-variant cue, without a specified genotype, dominance law, offspring ratio, allele frequency or guaranteed population outcome. The figure does not treat physical movement alone as sufficient genetic contribution.
independentReasoning.geometry: The movement arrow goes from donor to recipient; the reproduction/offspring arrow remains on the recipient side. Populations and generations are visibly separated by the river and local reproduction motif, not by a false color-transformation arrow.
independentReasoning.readability: The heading, dominant color differences, bridge direction, mating symbol and offspring motif are visible at both widths. Exact beetle counts are not an assessment datum and are not needed to read the mechanism.

wholeGoal.title: Theorien vergleichen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Darwin/Neodarwinismus mit alternativen Konzepten kontrastieren.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can contrast Darwinism/Neo-Darwinism with alternative concepts.

independentReasoning.observation: The left giraffe stretching toward leaves is explicitly marked Erworben vererbt? and Historische Behauptung. A central chromosome magnifier asks Erblich?. On the right, Variation and Selektion label a variable sampled giraffe population and an arrow toward a differently composed sample retaining a shorter individual.
independentReasoning.science: Question marks and the historical-claim label prevent acquired-character inheritance from being presented as an established fact. Pre-existing variation and changed population composition fit a selection contrast; the chromosome cue introduces heritable variation without asserting a specific neck-length locus, actual data, an individual growing by selection, or selection as the only evolutionary process. This is a simplified illustrative theory contrast, not evidence for the historical origin of giraffe necks.
independentReasoning.geometry: Panels separate the individual acquired-trait proposal from population-level variation/selection. Giraffes remain recognizable and the arrow links population samples rather than an individual neck elongation. The two stylized chromosome rods are a heredity icon, not a karyotype or phased genotype.
independentReasoning.readability: The four essential questions/headings and the differing population pictures remain readable at 360 and 680. No essential claim is hidden in a microscopic caption; the central Erblich? cue remains distinguishable.
